/bin/bash -c "sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/cookies.md && sed -n '145,190p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/cookies.md && sed -n '500,550p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/07-mutating-data.md && printf '\\n--- remaining app files ---\\n' && rg --files --hidden -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!/.git'"'"
